results.title: How to get Shadow the Hedgehog in Fortnite: Price, bundle, and more details
results.description: Fortnite’s Chapter 7 Season 4 Override has officially launched, featuring the introduction of Shadow and Knuckles. These beloved characters are now available in the Item Shop. Players can seize both characters along with a plethora of cosmetics for 3,600 V-Bucks or select Shadow individually for 1,800 V-Bucks. Hurry, as these exclusive items are only available until August 30, 2026.

results.title: Bunnie XO Is Gobbling Up Singlehood
results.description: Bunnie XO is loving being single, describing her DMs as a ‘boy buffet.’ She gushed on Today about how much fun she’s having: ‘Ladies, they should have never let me back out in the streets because I love it here.”
